change_summary: Keep continuation subject authority while resolving reusable patterns to their fitting Memory or Project Skill owner instead of writing into the currently visible evidence Page.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill distinguishes a continuation's subject evidence from the durable owner of a reusable pattern and routes a narrow same-scope owner search before admission or merge.

server_contract.note: The shared contract adds an existing durable-knowledge route and keeps the exact continuation handle as subject authority rather than an automatic write target.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.37 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.12.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI 0.1.0-beta.31 exposes the same subject-evidence versus durable-owner boundary in ask help while live contract discovery remains server-owned.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that reusable learning follows a same-scope Memory or Skill owner search instead of defaulting to the visible event or status Page.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The two owning RFCs and receipt-bound semantic review preserve the trigger failure, generic owner repair and transfer/countercase boundary.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover continuation subject authority, reusable-owner routing, compact MCP initialization, CLI help and public distribution parity.
